message: believe it or not, I 've been thinking along the same lines--how to devise an assignment where plagiarizing deliberately is part of the plan.  I think that this is great--you're beginning with the "plagiarized" text and then working towards a coherent essay.  It brings the concept down to a common sense, workable level, rather than leaving it in a place of mystification.  Brilliant, as the Guiness Beer ads would say.
